HAPPY_NOW_DOC: Restart triggerhappy once, immediately. This does not wait for Volumio to report ready.
HAPPY_FOREVER_DOC: On the next plugin start, including boot, poll VOLUMIO_SYSTEM_STATUS up to 60 times and restart triggerhappy on the first ready pass. If the loop ends without ready, restart anyway. Saving this switch does not restart and does not poll.
HAPPY_MORE_DOC: Open the binding editor. Save writes only lines that differ from other triggers.d confs, or removes this plugin's file when there are none. Turning this off removes the file. Restarts triggerhappy immediately. A remote taken over below runs the same map through the listener.
BINDING_DOC: Command run on press (event value 1). The stock line uses /usr/local/bin/volumio. There is no playlist verb.
LISTENER_STATUS_DOC: The plugin's own input listener: whether it runs, what it holds, and how many bindings it has.
LISTENER_ENABLED_DOC: Run the plugin's own listener for the remotes taken over below. A remote taken over leaves triggerhappy and is read by the listener alone, with the kernel's timestamps; everything else stays with triggerhappy. Save writes the listener's configuration and starts or stops it.
LONG_MS_DOC: A key held at least this long is a long press.
DOUBLE_MS_DOC: A second press within this gap after a release is a double press. A single press counts when the gap runs out.
DEBOUNCE_MS_DOC: Presses closer together than this are contact bounce and count once.
TAKE_OVER_DOC: Grab this remote exclusively, every input node of its name. Its keys run the editor's commands through the listener; triggerhappy no longer sees it.
FOREVER_SAVED: Saved. The ready poll runs the next time this plugin starts.
